business: Сервис бронирования столов со схемой зала (рабочее название), Актобе
target: Owners and managers of restaurants, lounges, karaoke bars and banquet halls in Aktobe, Kazakhstan, who take table bookings by phone, WhatsApp and Instagram Direct today. Prices are in Kazakh tenge; 19 900 tenge is about 42 US dollars. When asked about prices, answer for the MONTHLY fee, in tenge.

segments.name: Owner of a small café or lounge (one hall, 10-20 tables)
Owner of a large restaurant, banquet hall or karaoke complex
Hired manager or administrator who decides together with the owner

behaviours.name: Notebook loyalist
behaviours.how: The hostess writes every booking in a paper notebook; it has worked for years.

behaviours.name: WhatsApp-first
behaviours.how: Almost all bookings arrive in WhatsApp and Instagram Direct and are answered personally.

behaviours.name: Penny-pincher
behaviours.how: Counts every tenge of monthly fees and cancels subscriptions that do not pay off fast.

behaviours.name: Tech-curious
behaviours.how: Already uses a POS like iiko or Quick Resto and Kaspi QR; likes tools that save staff time.

behaviours.name: Banquet-heavy
behaviours.how: Most revenue comes from toi, birthdays and banquets booked weeks ahead with a deposit.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Paid for an app or a POS add-on before; the staff stopped using it within a month.

objections: 19 900 tenge every month for something a notebook does for free
Most of my guests call or write in WhatsApp, they will not book on a website
My hostess will not use another app on a busy Saturday
If it breaks on Saturday night, who do I call?
Is this a real company? I do not want my guests' phone numbers on some unknown site
We already have iiko and Kaspi, why another system
No-shows are my real problem, and this does not stop them
habits: on Friday and Saturday evenings the venue is full and the phone does not stop
on weekday evenings half your tables are empty
a big toi or birthday banquet is booked most weekends
you post the menu and events on Instagram and get booking requests in Direct
your hostess changes every few months and each new one needs training
